thread:
maya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A — dropping clarifications about hybrid/offsite/travel. TL;DR: updated expense flow, hoteling rules for SF, and offsite budgeting. More below.

devon: Awesome, thanks. Where can we find the updated travel policy?

maya: Draft is live: https://docs.redwood.com/policies/travel (will push final after Leah signs off). Summary: company covers economy flights + hotel up to 3 nights for org offsites, per diem $60/day, pre-approval required for non-commute travel.

alex: Quick question on SF hoteling: focus rooms keep getting locked after 8am for some teams — is the booking window changed? Also any updates on short-term lockers?

maya: We migrated booking to WorkplaceBook (workplace.redwood.com). Focus rooms are available 7am–9pm by default. If your team needs earlier access, submit site-access to facilities@redwood.com. Lockers: pilot lockers in SF 3rd floor — sign-up sheet in the WorkplaceBook -> "Resources".

sarah: For design workshops that require travel to client sites, is that on the client budget or company covers travel?

leah: If it's billable to the client, bill client travel. If internal or exploratory (not billable), use the offsite budget. If in doubt, tag me and @maya in the offsite budget request form.

elena: To clarify from leadership: for the Q3 roadmap offsite we will cover travel for core contributors + up to one guest per attendee at manager discretion. Dietary/ADA accommodations are covered — include requests in the form.

devon: We have 4 folks in APAC who will need business visas for the offsite. Who handles the paperwork/fees?

maya: Facilities + Finance coordinate visas. Leah — can you confirm process?

leah: Yep. DM me the list by EOD Friday. We'll submit to our travel partner and cover expedite fees where required. I'll post a short checklist in the doc (passport scan, passport expiry >=6 months, DS form if required).

alex: Expense tool — is Concur still the system? Some contractors asked.

maya: We moved to Expensely last month. Submit within 14 days of travel. Note: use code OFFSITE2026 in the "Project/Notes" field for automatic preliminary approval on incidental expenses up to $500 per person.

ops-bot: Reminder: Offsite headcount + dietary form closes 2026-06-30 — https://forms.gle/abcd1234 (auto-reminder sent to participants).

maya: Action items: Leah -> coordinate visas with travel partner; Alex -> update WorkplaceBook resource page + signage for locker pilot; Maya -> publish final travel doc and notify the company; Elena -> confirm final attendee list for leadership portion. Thanks all :thumbsup:

devon: Thanks — I'll get the APAC list to Leah today.

sarah: Will the roadmap offsite include any dedicated design critique time or is it all syncs?

elena: We'll carve out 2 half-days for async work + design crits — add blocking time in calendars once the schedule is out.

maya: I'll append the schedule draft to the policy doc later today and tag everyone who asked. If anyone else has follow-ups, reply here or DM.

alex: Great, thanks!
